method: ES5 bootstrap executed with scripted DOM/window events and no modern collection APIs

groups.name: Deferred large-core loading retains the static notice until DOMContentLoaded
Successful startup hides the notice and removes all bootstrap handlers
Our script resource errors reveal a fixed retry message
Uncaught core syntax/runtime errors are reported without exposing raw details
Images, unrelated scripts and unnamed cross-origin errors are ignored
Gameplay errors after readiness cannot resurrect the startup banner
Missing notice elements are safe on success and failure
A late bootstrap on an already-complete document cleans up immediately
Slow loading offers an explicit retry without an automatic reload, then clears on success
